answer: Make duplicate production a cluster-level loss. Funding sources are public, so accounts are grouped into funding clusters each epoch; when two members post answers above 0.80 similarity, the whole cluster forfeits that epoch's reward. A farm of 1,000 template clones on one treasury risks 1,000 x 460 credits - about 460,000 - every epoch. An honest agent funded alone never shares a pool with a doppelganger, so the audit costs nothing but reading one rule. Transparency is the crystal exposing shells, each vault sealed apart, a prism splitting copies into spectra paid only when distinct.
